items: A ranged or magic attack method
rec: Weapons, armour and food for the Ice Queen
Port Sarim teleport (Explorer's ring 2/3/4, Amulet of Glory to Draynor) (2)
Brimhaven teleport, or travel by boat from Ardougne/Port Sarim for 30gp
rewards: Ability to use the Fountain of Rune.
Ability to use Charge Dragonstone Jewellery scrolls.
Ability to purchase and equip Dragon Battleaxes and Maces.

st.t: Talk to Achietties outside the Heroes' Guild, south of Burthorpe.
s: I'm a hero, may I apply to join?
I'll start looking for all those things then.

st.t: You need to get an oily rod. Talk to Gerrant in Port Sarim to get some slime.
s: I want to find out how to catch a lava eel.

st.t: Combine the harralander potion (unf) with the blamish snail slime.
Use the Blamish oil on your fishing rod.

Go to Taverley Dungeon. With 70 Agility, squeeze through the obstacle pipe to reach the blue dragons. Otherwise you need a dusty key. If you don't have one, go through the dungeon to the Black Knights' Base, kill the Jailer on its east side for a jail key, use it on the south door and talk to Velrak. Ask him about good places to explore and say yes to the key. Don't ask for a reward. Then use the dusty key on the gate to the deeper part of the dungeon.
Fish a lava eel from the lava south of the blue dragons.
Cook the Lava Eel at a range. You cannot fail this.

tr: Port Sarim teleport (Explorer's ring 2/3/4, Amulet of Glory to Draynor)

st.t: Do this section only if you joined the Black Arm Gang in Shield of Arrav. If you joined the Phoenix Gang, skip to "Thieves' armband (Phoenix Gang)". You need a partner: another player who joined the Phoenix Gang. Talk to Katrine at the Black Arm Gang base in south west Varrock.
s: Is there any way I can get the rank of master thief?

st.t: Try to enter the gang's house in east Brimhaven, along the fence just south of the Agility Arena.
Talk to Trobert inside.
s: So can you help me get Scarface Pete's candlesticks?
I volunteer to undertake that mission!

st.t: Equip your black armour and enter the mansion in the north west of Brimhaven.
Talk to Grip.
Get a miscellaneous key from Grip, then give it to your partner.
s: So what do my duties involve?

st.t: Go into the room north-east of the entrance and wait for your partner to reach the room behind its east wall. Then search the cupboard to lure Grip in, and close the door once he's inside. Your partner should kill him.
s: He won't notice me having a quick look.

st.t: Pick up Grip's keyring
Go to the north-west part of the mansion and use Grip's keyring on the treasure room door.
Search the chest in the treasure room for two candlesticks.
Give one of Pete's candlesticks to your partner. Afterwards, return to Katrine with Pete's candlestick

tr: Brimhaven teleport, or travel by boat from Ardougne/Port Sarim for 30gp

st.t: Do this section only if you joined the Phoenix Gang in Shield of Arrav. If you joined the Black Arm Gang, skip to "Get ice gloves". You need a partner: another player who joined the Black Arm Gang. Head into the Phoenix Gang's base in south Varrock.
Talk to Straven.
Talk to Alfonse the Waiter in the restaurant in Brimhaven.
i: A ranged or magic attack method

st.t: You'll need your partner to give you a miscellaneous key.
Talk to Charlie the Cook in the back of the restaurant.
s: I want to steal Scarface Pete's candlesticks.

st.t: Push the wall panel next to the range to enter Pete's garden.
Cross the garden and go in through the mansion's east door. Inside, use the miscellaneous key on the door to the north.
Wait for your partner to lure Grip into the room next to yours, and kill him with magic/ranged. Afterwards, trade your partner for a candlestick.
Bring the candlestick back to Straven.

i: A ranged or magic attack method
tr: Brimhaven teleport, or travel by boat from Ardougne/Port Sarim for 30gp

st.t: Head to White Wolf Mountain, and mine a rockslide in the northern part.
Take the south east ladder down.
Follow the tunnel south, then go up the ladder there.
Take the east ladder down.
Follow the path around until you reach a ladder, then climb it.
Take the north ladder down.
Kill the Ice Queen for ice gloves.
Bank your weapons and armour, but keep the ice gloves. Then travel to Entrana with the monks in Port Sarim.
Equip your ice gloves. Kill the Entrana firebird near the Law Altar in the north of Entrana, then pick up the fire feather.

tr: Port Sarim teleport (Explorer's ring 2/3/4, Amulet of Glory to Draynor)

st.t: Bring Achietties all the items to finish.
